verdict.rationale: The evidence describes function calling (model-initiated tool invocation during a conversation) and structured output, but there is no documentation of a rules/trigger engine that fires actions automatically on external events (e.g., webhooks, schedulers, event listeners) — the closest analog, function calling, is reactive to a request/response turn, not an event-driven automation rule system. missing for 10: evidence of event-based triggers, webhook/subscription support, or a rules engine for autonomous action execution.
